final: WITH status_counts AS (SELECT s.healtheval, COUNT(*) AS record_count FROM scanconservation AS c JOIN sites AS s ON s.zoneregistry = c.zoneref GROUP BY s.healtheval), shares AS (SELECT record_count, 1.0 * record_count / SUM(record_count) OVER () AS share FROM status_counts), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(shares.record_count) AS average_count, AVG(shares.share) AS average_share, AVG(shares.share - baseline.average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM shares CROSS JOIN baseline WHERE shares.share > baseline.average_share
